'''2009 Bespin Regionals Tanner Barnhart DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tanner Barnhart]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The name of my deck is TTO also known as That Thing's Operational which is a very good deck and is also pretty cool
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
